status_definitions.not_triggered: 能力从未进入运行时 clause。
status_definitions.triggered_passed: 能力已进入并至少执行一次操作。
status_definitions.triggered_not_executed: 能力已进入，但因条件、目标、容量或安全分支未执行操作。

scope.sampling_scope: 1.11 instrumentation contract and one deterministic smoke; forced scenarios and 1,000-game coverage belong to 1.12

acceptance.note: This accepts the 1.11 instrumentation contract only. not_triggered clauses remain open evidence for 1.12.
